title: feat(spec)!: one marketplace taxonomy — business functions, industries, a solution type and maturity replace the single category
body:
Fixes #30904

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — new facet keys and `maturity` widen; `category` retired and refused by name narrows; a contract review runs before the queue
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

> The claim (card comment 6683208761) and the dispatch declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)` / `Metadata-protocol: none`. `Check Changeset` refuses that pair on this diff, measured locally: `metadata-protocol declares none while an authorable-surface or authorable-defaults baseline moved` (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/marketplace.json`). AGENTS.md defines a tombstoned key as `narrowed`, and `narrowed` needs the `(narrowing)` arm and a `minor`, so the two lines above and the changeset carry that pair. The seat can still rule otherwise; see Acceptance notes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 市场分类在 spec 里只定义一处：职能 `businessFunctions`（1–3 个，第一个是主职能）、行业 `industries`（0–3 个，可选）、类型 `solutionType`（app / template / connector），另加独立的 `maturity`（beta / stable）。两份旧的 `category` 按 ADR-0087 退役，带 `category` 的发布被点名拒绝并给出改法。
- **为什么改：** 一个 `category` 同时表示“给谁用”和“是什么”，平台和 cloud 各有一套取值且互相对不上；按维护者裁决 D1–D3 合并为一套。空白模板的 `"starter"` 会让每个新项目第一次发布被 cloud 拒绝，这里一并删掉。
- **风险与回滚：** 破坏性：还写着 `category` 的清单在发布时被拒（附映射）。运行时启动不读这些 schema，不受影响。cloud 在 cloud#3661 落地前会忽略新字段，且其提交审核仍要求 `category`，需要先落 cloud 再发 CLI（见 Acceptance notes）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts`（取值、上限、交叉校验、旧值映射）；`packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` 的 `retiredCategoryRefusal` / `readPublishTaxonomy`；`packages/spec/liveness/template_manifest.json`（新纳入的台账与消费方）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/marketplace/taxonomy.test.ts`，预期 39 个测试全部通过；在任一 `objectstack.manifest.json` 里加 `"category": "finance"` 后跑 `os package publish`，预期在联网前被拒，提示 `"businessFunctions": ["finance"], "solutionType": "app"`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地（契约复核后由席位决定声明行与发布顺序）。

## What changes

<details><summary>spec — the taxonomy, defined once</summary>

- New `packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/spec/marketplace`:
  - `MarketplaceBusinessFunctionSchema` (11 values, ruling §2 F1) and `MarketplaceBusinessFunctionsSchema` (1–3 distinct, ordered, the first is primary).
  - `MarketplaceIndustrySchema` (10 values, §2 F2 / D1) and `MarketplaceIndustriesSchema` (0–3 distinct; no catch-all value — absence means cross-industry).
  - `MarketplaceSolutionTypeSchema` (`app` | `template` | `connector`; no `theme`, ADR-0019) and `PackageMaturitySchema` (`beta` | `stable`, D3 — a flag, not a facet).
  - `explainSolutionTypeContradiction(solutionType, { installModes, connectorCount })` — the publish cross-check: `template` needs `unmanaged` among the install modes (ADR-0131 D6), `connector` needs a declared connector. One rule and one sentence for the CLI and, through cloud#3661, the cloud publish gate.
  - `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` — ruling §3.1 + §3.2: every value of the retired spec enum, the cloud list and its folded aliases → `mapped` / `manual` (author chooses the functions; never a catch-all) / `unlistable` (ADR-0019). `operations` is mapped and flagged `review`.
- `PackageSchema` / `CreatePackageRequestSchema` / `UpdatePackageRequestSchema` / `TemplateManifestSchema` / `MarketplaceListingSchema` carry the four keys. Row shapes default `solutionType: 'app'` and `maturity: 'stable'`; requests and the manifest carry no default (absent stays absent, so a re-publish never rewrites a stored value). `businessFunctions` is required on the listing.
- `MarketplaceSearchRequestSchema` filters by `businessFunctions` / `industries` / `solutionTypes` (OR inside a facet, AND across) and `maturity`; `MarketplaceSearchResponseSchema.facets` has one count list per facet.

</details>

<details><summary>spec — the ADR-0087 retirement of both category schemas</summary>

- `category` is a `retiredKey()` tombstone on all six schemas (and `facets.categories` on the search response). The schemas are not strict, so a bare deletion would strip silently; the tombstone refuses with the prescription in both channels (`tsc`, parse). `TemplateManifestSchema` re-declares its own so the refusal names the file an author writes.
- `MarketplaceCategorySchema` / `MarketplaceCategory` and `PackageCategorySchema` / `PackageCategory` are deleted: `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]` (two entries), the deliberate `json-schema.manifest/marketplace.json` deletion, and the two `scripts/lib/renamed-defs.ts` rows retired with a note.
- Registration: six `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` entries, one D3 semantic entry `marketplace-category-retired`, one `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment. **No D2 conversion**: none of these shapes is a stack collection member (the `marketplace/PackageDependency:optional` precedent), so a conversion would be a transform no seam runs.
- **Publish-time and boot-time consequence** for a manifest that still carries `category`: publish refuses it (the CLI before any network call; a parse of any of the schemas, with the prescription). Boot: nothing — no runtime boot reads `objectstack.manifest.json`, a package row or a listing (measured: the only readers of the file are `os package publish`, create-objectstack and `check:template-manifests`). So there is nothing for the boot to tolerate or refuse; ADR-0087's load-path conversion has no seam here, and the decision recorded in the D3 entry is refuse-at-publish, migrate-stored-rows-once (cloud#3661, reading `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING`).
- Generated: `authorable-surface`, `authorable-defaults`, `json-schema.manifest`, `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `declaration-map`, `content/docs/references/marketplace/**`, the strictness-ledger counts; `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` declares the uniqueness refinement on the two facet lists (no projectable arm for "distinct items" exists); six ADR-0122 isomorphic pins (837 → 841).

</details>

<details><summary>CLI, first-party manifests, scenario library, docs</summary>

- `os package publish` (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts`):
  - refuses `category` in `objectstack.manifest.json` and the now-hidden `--category` flag before any network call, naming the facets for the value it held (from `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING`); a `starter` copied from the blank template is told it never classified the package;
  - judges each facet with the spec's own schema, cross-checks a declared `solutionType` against the built artifact (`resolveInstallModes` + the artifact's `connectors`), and sends them as `business_functions` / `industries` / `solution_type` / `maturity`; an absent facet is not sent.
- Manifests: connector-stripe `[finance]`, connector-github `[it]`, connector-docusign `[collaboration, legal]`, each `solutionType: connector` (their listing tests now assert the stack declares the connector that makes them one). The create-objectstack blank template drops `category: "starter"` and declares **no** facet: create-objectstack copies this file into every scaffolded project, so a facet here would be inherited by projects it does not describe, and a `template` there would be refused by the new cross-check on the first publish (the blank config permits only `managed`).
- `packages/qa/scenarios`: the hand copy `SCENARIO_CATEGORIES` is gone; a card's key is `businessFunctions`, typed by the spec schema. The nine cards are re-tagged per ruling §3.3.
- Docs: `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, `content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx`, `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` — no hand copy of the value lists (the handbook links the generated taxonomy reference).
- Liveness: `objectstack.manifest.json` (`TemplateManifestSchema`) enters the ledger as `template_manifest` via `SPEC_ONLY_SCHEMAS`. `businessFunctions` / `industries` / `maturity` are `planned`, naming their consumers — the cloud catalog (objectstack-ai/cloud#3661) and the console marketplace card the seat files; `solutionType` is `live` through the publish cross-check; `category` is the tombstone row. The platform checklist carries a measured waiver for it (no checklist item can drive a hosted publish).

</details>

## Tests

Measured on head `7cd7fe941c` (the commits after it are the changeset declaration and nothing a test reads).

<details><summary>Suites</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` — exit 0 (818 + 1 files; the one earlier red, the dropped-refinements header totals, fixed and re-run green: 27/27).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` — exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` — exit 0, `Test Files 390 passed (390)`, `Tests 5496 passed (5496)`. Integration tier declared to CI (no spawn entry or driver path touched).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` — exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter create-objectstack test` / `typecheck` — exit 0 / 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test` / `typecheck` — exit 0 / 0.
- connector-stripe / connector-github / connector-docusign `test` — exit 0 each.
- New: `packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.test.ts` (39 cases: one block per rule — F1, F2, F3, D3, the cross-check, the refusal on every schema, the registration, the mapping) and `packages/cli/test/package-publish-taxonomy.test.ts` (14 cases).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations — one per rule, each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs (mutation proven on disk, restore proven against HEAD)</summary>

| Rule | Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| F1 at most 3 | `.max(MAX_BUSINESS_FUNCTIONS,` → `.max(99,` | 1 failed / 39 — "refuses a fourth value" |
| F1 at least 1 | `.min(1,` → `.min(0,` | 1 failed / 39 |
| F1/F2 distinct | the refine predicate → always true | 2 failed / 39 |
| F2 at most 3 | `.max(MAX_INDUSTRIES,` → `.max(99,` | 1 failed / 39 |
| template needs unmanaged | the template branch → `if (false)` | 1 failed / 39 |
| connector needs a connector | the connector branch → `if (false)` | 1 failed / 39 |
| category tombstone | delete `CreatePackageRequest.category` | 2 failed / 39 (the refusal and the tsc pin) |
| CLI refuses manifest `category` | the guard → `if (false)` | 2 failed / 14 |
| CLI refuses `--category` | the guard → `if (false)` | 1 failed / 14 |
| CLI wires the cross-check | delete the refusal return | 3 failed / 14 |

Every leg ends `git diff HEAD` empty for its file; the final tree carried 0 modified source paths.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

<details><summary>Every caller class that newly sees a refusal</summary>

1. A TypeScript author writing `category` on `Package` / `CreatePackageRequest` / `UpdatePackageRequest` / `TemplateManifest` / `MarketplaceListing` / `MarketplaceSearchRequest` — `tsc` error (the retired mark).
2. Any code parsing those schemas with `category` present — parse refusal with the prescription. Measured at cloud `8f574b9`: cloud reads only `PackageSchema.shape.manifestId` and `CreatePackageRequestSchema.shape.tags`, so its pin bump is not refused by this.
3. A TypeScript importer of `MarketplaceCategorySchema` / `PackageCategorySchema` / their types — compile error (zero importers here and in cloud at `8f574b9`).
4. `os package publish` with `category` in `objectstack.manifest.json` — refused before any network call. This includes every project already scaffolded from the blank template (`"starter"`).
5. `os package publish --category …` — refused.
6. A manifest declaring `solutionType: template` without the `unmanaged` install mode, or `connector` with no connector, or a malformed facet — refused (new keys, no existing caller).
7. A producer of `MarketplaceListingSchema` without `businessFunctions` — refused (new requirement; no producer in this repo).
8. A scenario card with `category`, or a business function outside the facet — loader refusal.
9. `check:template-manifests` — any shipped manifest with `category` reds.

</details>

<details><summary>Sequencing, declarations and what this PR deliberately does not do</summary>

- **Cloud sequencing (needs the seat's call):** at cloud `8f574b9` the publish route picks named body keys, so the four facets are dropped until objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 lands, and `marketplace-policy.ts` still requires `category` at marketplace submission. A CLI released from this PR before cloud#3661 deploys can no longer satisfy that submission rule for a package that has no stored category. Order: cloud#3661 (accept the facets, require a business function instead of `category`) before the next CLI release reaches authors.
- **Declarations:** see the quote under the declaration lines. The pair here is what `Check Changeset` accepts and what AGENTS.md defines; if the seat keeps `none`, the changeset must go back to `patch` and the level gate stays red on the moved authorable-surface shard.
- **Blank template reproduction:** reproduced in two halves, not end to end. Cloud half executed: cloud `8f574b9`'s `isValidPackageCategory("starter")` returns `false` (the route answers 400 on it at `package-publish.ts:896`). CLI half read: at the base, publish sent `m.category` verbatim and create-objectstack copied the template's `category` into every project.
- **Kebab-case values** (`customer-service`, `trade-distribution`, …) are the ruling's verbatim values and match the marketplace enums' existing spelling (`usage-based`, `in-review`); Prime Directive #3's snake_case is the general rule for machine names.
- **`explainSolutionTypeContradiction` lives in the spec** as a pure function beside `resolveInstallModes`, so the CLI and the cloud gate share one rule and one sentence instead of two copies.
- **Liveness enrolment found more than the taxonomy:** `name`, `specVersion`, `skills`, `scaffold`, and the warned-and-unsent `visibility` / `publisher` / `isStarter` have no reader of the file's value. Recorded `dead` in the new ledger, not retired here.
- Not touched: HotCRM's manifest (hotcrm lane); cloud (cloud#3661); the console `ui/` (the seat files that card); `docs/design/marketplace-publishing.md` (a design record whose `--category` search example describes a command this repo does not ship).

</details>
